==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], juiced
* 2 [[Cookbook:Orange|oranges]], juiced
* 4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:Rhubarb|rhubarb]], cut into small pieces
* 1 pound [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
* 3 pounds [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure==

# Combine the lemon juice, orange juice, and rhubarb.
# [[Cookbook:Chop|Chop]] lemon and orange rind along with raisins; add to rhubarb mixture.
# Mix all and let stand for 30 minutes.
# Add sugar and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]], then [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] for 1 hour, stirring often.
# When the mixture gets thick, pour into glasses or crock.
# When cool, seal.
